# Authentication

Part of the **Security & Authentication** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## Login

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/login`

Authenticate user and generate API token



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `email` | string | Yes | User email address |
| `password` | string | Yes | User password |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/login" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "email": "admin@example.com",
  "password": "password"
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/login", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "email": "admin@example.com",
  "password": "password"
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/login', [
    'headers' => [
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'email' => 'admin@example.com',
    'password' => 'password',
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/login"

headers = {
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

payload = {
    "email": "admin@example.com",
    "password": "password",
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

**Example response** <Badge type="info" text="200" />

```json
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "1|abcd1234efgh5678ijkl...",
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Admin User",
    "email": "admin@example.com"
  }
}
```

::: details Error response — 401

```json
{
  "message": "The provided credentials are incorrect."
}
```

:::

## Logout

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/logout`

Revoke current API token

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.




::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/logout" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/logout", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/logout', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/logout"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

**Example response** <Badge type="info" text="200" />

```json
{
  "message": "Logout successful"
}
```

::: details Error response — 401

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated."
}
```

:::
